materials.name: Graphene Lattice
materials.desc: Carbon reduced out of harvested biomass and rolled into single-atom sheeting.

materials.name: Boron Nitride Ceramic
materials.desc: Hexagonal boron nitride. It insulates against current and carries heat away from a drill face.

materials.name: Deuterium Slush
materials.desc: Heavy hydrogen distilled from the metallic phase and frozen to a slurry that still pumps.

materials.name: Silica Aerogel
materials.desc: Almost entirely vacuum by volume, and still rigid enough to machine.

materials.name: High-Entropy Alloy Billet
materials.desc: Five principal elements in solid solution, with no host lattice left to fatigue.

materials.name: YBCO Tape
materials.desc: Yttrium barium copper oxide, superconducting well above the boiling point of its own coolant.

materials.name: Metamaterial Film
materials.desc: A lattice finer than the light it bends, so light leaves it going the wrong way.

materials.name: Bose-Einstein Condensate Cell
materials.desc: A few million atoms held microkelvins above absolute zero, sharing a single wavefunction.

materials.name: Casimir Plate Stack
materials.desc: Plates spaced nanometres apart. The vacuum between them presses them together.

materials.name: Penning Positron Trap
materials.desc: Crossed magnetic and electrostatic fields hold antimatter away from the walls, and mostly succeed.

materials.name: Degenerate Matter Core
materials.desc: A splinter of neutron star, held at pressure by nothing but the refusal of its own electrons.

materials.name: Muon-Catalysed Fusion Cell
materials.desc: Muons draw deuterium nuclei close enough to fuse at room temperature, and last two microseconds doing it.
